امتدحن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَدَحْنَ (imtadaḥna) /im.ta.daħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# اُمْتُدِحْنَ (umtudiḥna) /um.tu.diħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# اِمْتَدِحْنَ (imtadiḥna) /im.ta.diħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
